def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); p=[]
            while q:
                x,y=q.pop(); p.append((x,y))
                for dx in (-1,0,1):
                    for dy in (-1,0,1):
                        a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and grid[a][b]!=0 and (a,b) not in seen:
                            seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
            r0=min(x for x,y in p); c0=min(y for x,y in p)
            comps.append([(x-r0,y-c0) for x,y in p])
    H=max(x for p in comps for x,y in p)+1
    W=max(y for p in comps for x,y in p)+1
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for p in comps:
        ph=max(x for x,y in p)+1; pw=max(y for x,y in p)+1

            out[x+(H-ph)//2][y+(W-pw)//2]=grid[next(r for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=0 and False)][0] if False else 1
    color=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v)
    return [[color if v else 0 for v in row] for row in out]
